name: HollowNeRF Saliency Grid Weighting
definition: A trainable 3D grid G that stores saliency values to weight feature vectors fetched from a multi-level hashgrid, effectively learning a probability distribution P(x) of feature presence to mitigate hash collisions.
summary: HollowNeRF Saliency Grid Weighting mitigates hash collisions by learning a 3D probability distribution to weight feature vectors, allowing important features to dominate shared buckets while pruning less significant ones.
